feature: Password reset with a single-use link that expires after 30 minutes

test_cases.title: Request a reset link for a registered email
preconditions: A registered user has access to their email inbox.
steps: Open the received reset link within 30 minutes.
Enter and confirm a valid new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The password is changed and the user can sign in with the new password.

test_cases.title: Do not reveal whether an email is registered
steps: Request a reset link using a registered email address and record the confirmation message.
Request a reset link using an unregistered email address.
test_cases.expected_result: Both requests display the same neutral confirmation and do not reveal account existence.

test_cases.title: Reject a reset link after 30 minutes
preconditions: A password reset link was issued more than 30 minutes ago.
steps: Attempt to set a new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The password is not changed and the user is told that the link has expired.

test_cases.title: Reject a reset link that has already been used
preconditions: A password reset link has already been used successfully.
steps: Open the same reset link again.
Attempt to enter another new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The reused link is rejected and the password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Submit an empty email address
preconditions: The password reset page is open.
test_cases.expected_result: The request is not submitted and a clear validation message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Navigate the reset form using only a keyboard
preconditions: The password reset page is open.
steps: Navigate through the form using Tab and Shift+Tab.
Submit the form using the keyboard.
test_cases.expected_result: Every interactive element has a visible focus state and the form can be completed without a mouse.
